reason: Rank cache_conflict_layout first: it directly tests a change to how the existing four-tile kernel consumes its packed A panels, while preserving its traversal and FP32 updates. This is a concrete cache-layout hypothesis, but its benefit is unmeasured and stride/bounds changes create correctness risk. Rank constant_shape_512 second: fixed bounds may help code generation, but it retains the full transpose and appears more likely to duplicate work the compiler already specializes. Neither proposal establishes a gain; judge candidates against fresh paired controls.
